title: Speak to Dotson

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: There you are, my fellow sleuthhound, my gumshoe pal! We have a case! A most confounding case!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There you are, my fellow sleuthhound, my gumshoe pal! We have a case! A most confounding case!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: There has been a possible fatality at the Grundown Ritz! So far there are only rumors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There has been a possible fatality at the Grundown Ritz! So far there are only rumors.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: That a guest of Ms Minty Chrome-Valience was found deceased last night in a most COMPROMISING manner!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That a guest of Ms Minty Chrome-Valience was found deceased last night in a most COMPROMISING manner!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: A bold deduction! How do you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A bold deduction! How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: With you! How confounding. What were you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With you! How confounding. What were you doing?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And where did this perambulation occur?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And where did this perambulation occur?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Indeed… and what time was this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed… and what time was this?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Gadzooks, then you are her alibi my dear friend!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gadzooks, then you are her alibi my dear friend!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Then the mystery remains unsolved… dear me. Dear dear me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then the mystery remains unsolved… dear me. Dear dear me.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: If you are indeed her alibi, then all of my deductive processes have been incorrect. I thought my sleuthing powers were second to none... this is terrible. I must go and reflect on my failings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you are indeed her alibi, then all of my deductive processes have been incorrect. I thought my sleuthing powers were second to none... this is terrible. I must go and reflect on my failings.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Gadzooks, then she could indeed have been at the scene during the event in question! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gadzooks, then she could indeed have been at the scene during the event in question! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Much as I admire your digestive tract, I will need more to go on, in this case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Much as I admire your digestive tract, I will need more to go on, in this case.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Gadzooks, you're right! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gadzooks, you're right! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Gadzooks! So she WAS at the hotel! I will conclude my investigation forthwith!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gadzooks! So she WAS at the hotel! I will conclude my investigation forthwith!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: But now that Dotson is on the job you can rest assured that the mystery will be swiftly solved.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But now that Dotson is on the job you can rest assured that the mystery will be swiftly solved.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: But it is puzzling. I have interviewed Ms Valience and she insists that she was nowhere near the scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But it is puzzling. I have interviewed Ms Valience and she insists that she was nowhere near the scene.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What have you heard?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What have you heard?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s right. She was with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s right. She was with me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That’s right. She was with me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That’s right. She was with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bare-faced lies! She was there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bare-faced lies! She was there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because she would have been seen by Nets reporters if she had left the hotel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because she would have been seen by Nets reporters if she had left the hotel.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because she would have been seen by Nets reporters if she had left the hotel.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because she would have been seen by Nets reporters if she had left the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because Hanz Grundown tried to bribe me to be her alibi.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because Hanz Grundown tried to bribe me to be her alibi.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because Hanz Grundown tried to bribe me to be her alibi.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because Hanz Grundown tried to bribe me to be her alibi.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gut instinct.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gut instinct.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just talking. We went for a walk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just talking. We went for a walk.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just talking. We went for a walk.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just talking. We went for a walk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Skyhigh Gardens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Skyhigh Gardens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Docks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Docks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Spire.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Between 23:04 and 23:49

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Between 23:04 and 23:49

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Between 02:05 and 02:11.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Between 02:05 and 02:11.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems that way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems that way.
